Sent: the list was the message

Pins are the one pin component (Fives,: pbx-pin, pbx-reg, pbx-ov, pbx-pnote, pbx-plist, pbx-sent). On a picture a click means nothing else, so pin mode is always on and there is no tool: a click drops a numbered pin, a drag a region, the note is typed beside it, Enter ends it. The list under the picture is the message. Send to checkout (the agent of the pane in front), or ⌘↩, then "Sent to checkout 14:07". Presses: a click, the words, ⌘↩.
